chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
If the witness says that he sat with her in the manner of a man with his wife, the hadd punishment is carried out against him.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man, in the expression comparing conjugal conduct
key_terms.امْرَأَتِهِ: his wife, used to indicate the known manner of intimate relation
key_terms.جَلَسَ: sat or positioned himself, used here as part of a legal descriptive expression
key_terms.مَجْلِسَ: the manner or position of sitting

ai.seo_question: What kind of witness statement establishes the hadd punishment in a zina case according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning testimony in a zina case and the circumstances under which the hadd punishment is established. It reflects the precise judicial language used in fiqh regarding evidentiary description for enforcing legal penalties.
